== Used in ==
{{recipe list}}

== Notes ==
* Each component Gift requires map completion of the respective zone, that the associated heart has been completed that day (except for [[Gift of the Highlands]]), and costs {{karma|23331}}, for a total of {{karma|93324}}.
* Each component Gift can be purchased only once per character, so Gift of the Desert can be crafted only once per character.
** Oddly, [[Gift of the Rider]] is unlimited, even though it can only be used together with Gift of the Desert.
